column3: The Hebrew explicitly names wrongdoing rather than ways; BSB says their ways are vile.
The Hebrew asks whether they know and states they did not call on God; BSB asks whether they will learn and says they refuse to call.
The Hebrew has a singular one who besieged you; BSB has those who besieged you.
The Hebrew has salvations in the plural and turning captivity; BSB has singular salvation and restoring captive people.
